title: Preserve dollar signs in CLI label values
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

When `--label` flags are provided on the `buildah build` or `podman build` CLI, Buildah synthesizes a `LABEL` instruction line and appends it to the list of build instructions for `imagebuilder`.

Because `imagebuilder` performs shell-style word expansion, literal `$` characters in label values (e.g., `--label foo='$5 off'`) were being evaluated as variable references and dropped when unresolved.

This PR escapes literal `$` characters as `\$` in the generated instruction line, ensuring `imagebuilder` preserves `$` as literal text without affecting other characters or existing escaping behavior.

#### How to verify it

1. Build a container image using a label containing a `$` character:

   ```bash
   echo "FROM busybox" > Dockerfile
   ./bin/buildah build -t test-label . --label 'test=$something'
   ```

2. Inspect the image annotations/labels to verify `$` was preserved:

   ```bash
   ./bin/buildah inspect --format '{{ index .ImageAnnotations "test" }}' test-label
   ```

   **Expected output:**

   ```text
   $something
   ```

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Fixes [https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29095](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29095)

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

This bug was reported in the Podman repository (`podman-container-tools/podman`), but the issue resides in Buildah's synthesized instruction parsing before handing them off to `imagebuilder`.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

Yes.

Fixed an issue where literal `$` characters in CLI `--label` values were stripped during build instruction expansion.
